 The Beavers put their five-game winning streak to the test Halloween night with a trip to Fresno State . Oregon State (5-2) is coming off a bye, while Fresno State (4-3) also had a bye last week after consecutive losses at home to Boise State (38-31) and at San Diego State (26-23).

 Oregon State vs. Fresno State updates, score, analysis
 Oregon State receiving poll votes
 10:25 PM ET, October 31 2026, Landon Bartlett 
 Oregon State's five-game win streak has sparked national conversation about whether or not the Beavers should be ranked.
 OSU's only two losses came in the first two games of the season, to top-25 ranked Houston and Texas Tech. Since then, the Beavers have been one of the nation's most explosive offenses and rattled dominant win after dominant win.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement In USA Today's most recent coaches poll , Oregon State received 15 votes. In the AP Top 25 poll, the Beavers received 10 votes.
 The Beavers have the opportunity for a statement win against 4-3 Fresno State Saturday evening following the bye week.
 Jesse Legree commits future to OSU
 10:07 PM ET, October 31 2026, Landon Bartlett 
 On Oct. 23, freshman receiver Jesse Legree committed his future to the Beavers' football program. It gained national attention and was a vote of confidence from the breakout star that he's staying in Corvallis for the long term.
 Legree announced his commitment to the Beavers' in front of a crowd of people in his hometown of Baltimore, Maryland, with the logo of his former high school, St. Frances Academy, as a backdrop.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "People don't realize how important it is for that young man to go back and represent his city, Baltimore, Maryland, and represent his high school in a very, very passionate yet positive way" Beavers coach JaMarcus Shephard said. "He's doing everything he can to let people in his community know that they have the opportunity and ability to be successful regardless of what anybody thinks about them."
 "He's going to have impact with a lot of younger athletes and things of that nature because of things he did this past week," Shephard said.
 Legree has made Heisman Trophy waves in recent weeks. Legree is fourth in Heisman's own ongoing fan vote. The Athletic lists Legree with the fifth-best odds to win the award, while USA Today slots Legree as the fourth candidate .
 What channel is Oregon State vs. Fresno State on today?
 09:45 PM ET, October 31 2026, Jesse Sowa 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement TV channel: USA Network
 Streaming: Sling TV 
 Oregon State vs. Fresno State will broadcast on USA Sports of the USA Network in Week 9 of the 2026 college football season. Streaming options include Sling TV , Hulu + Live TV, YouTube TV and DirecTV Stream, all of which carry the USA Network.
 Nate Gatter and Ryan Leaf will call the game from the booth at Valley Children's Stadium, with Lauren Green reporting from the sidelines.
